meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Rinse FM's promo hero banner and row arrows; blur or hide show artwork on cards
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, rinse.fm home page (Next.js). Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate); see the per-rule counts in the playbook. Rinse uses Tailwind utility classes and hashed `c-` classes for layout, so only the readable `rns-card` and `rns-grid-*` classes are used. The promo banner is matched by the outbound campaign link (`bfan.link`), which is a campaign-dependent hook: a rule that stops matching is harmless. The banner contains the only autoplaying video on the home page (3 video elements), so it is hidden with the banner. Carousel arrows (`.rns-grid-slider > button`) are an extra Hide option.

NOT verified: show, schedule and radio-station pages, the persistent player, desktop layout, cookie consent (none appeared), and the original ad and app-banner rules.
